traits.name: Steady Balance
traits.text: Whenever the harbormaster rolls a success on a check to Balance, they get a critical success instead. They're not flat-footed while Balancing on narrow surfaces and uneven ground. They can attempt an Acrobatics check instead of a Reflex save to Grab an Edge.

traits.name: Items
traits.text: fishing tackle, hatchet (2), ledger, manacles, spyglass;

traits.name: Experienced Hand
traits.text: The harbormaster has endured their share of adverse conditions at sea. Any creature that's in adverse weather or aboard a vessel on rough water is flat-footed to the harbormaster.

actions.text: ⬻ hatchet +11 (agile, sweep, thrown 10 feet); Damage 1d6+7 (1d6+7) slashing
